sentence: This project studies how early-life adversity at the individual, household and community level leaves epigenetic marks in Mexican American children.
This project builds a microscopic nuclear imaging tool that shows where clinical radiotracers spread at cellular level inside a thick, living specimen.
This project uses molecular recording technologies to find out where blood development starts and what drives it.
This project examines how a host protein restricts viral replication through interactions between viral and host factors.
This project applies genetics to basic cell and developmental biology and to developmental diseases.
This project studies how chronic inflammatory pathways contribute to coronary microvascular dysfunction and heart failure in aging women.
This project tests how genes and synthetic DNA constructs change the ability of engineered T cells to treat cancer in preclinical models.
This project studies how alcohol use relates to suicide risk in daily life for people returning to the community after alcohol use disorder treatment.
This project compares immune cells from blood and synovial fluid during gout flares to see how cell responses and gene expression change.
This project studies how real-time changes in positive and negative social motivation shape loneliness, mood and social interactions in persons with schizophrenia.
This project provides advanced microscopes and sample preparation so researchers can study how glycans affect cellular function.
This project uses sequencing technology and disease-specific model systems to find the genetic causes of white matter disease in undiagnosed children.
This project provides sequencing, spatial and single cell technologies for genomic, transcriptomic and epigenetic studies of cancer.
This project measures neuroinflammation alongside amyloid, tau and neurodegeneration in a cohort of middle-aged Hispanics.
This project builds gene editing tools that correct the mutation behind alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency and tests them in mouse and ferret models.
This project studies how two pathways in cells tip the balance between degeneration and protection in tauopathies.
This project studies the molecular mechanisms that control the shape of mitochondria in human cells.
This project builds a tool that edits and controls gut bacteria in place, and tests it against bacteria linked to colorectal cancer.
This project develops a fluorescence immunoassay based on surface plasmon resonance, using a super-hydrophobic surface.
This project uses a computational phenotyping approach to study neurogenetic disorders and factors that determine outcomes in childhood epilepsies.
